summary: Assess portfolio dependencies and climate risks, interpret scenarios and set governance actions. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: Climate and nature risk management helps financial teams assess portfolio dependencies, impacts and hazards. For bank risk and sustainability teams, insurers, regulators, development-finance institutions and financial-risk advisers, the course practises setting portfolio boundaries, screening nature dependencies with ENCORE, and translating NGFS scenarios and climate hazards into material risk priorities. Participants also map governance, monitoring and committee actions, producing screening records, scenario matrices and a portfolio action plan while accounting for data gaps and limited analytical capacity.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, oversee or advise on how climate and nature factors affect financial portfolios and institutional risk decisions.
modules: IPCC Hazard Pathways and Financial Exposure
NGFS Risk Actions and Committee Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial risk management and portfolio exposures is expected. No coding or programming is required.
